title_es_or_en: Philip Schaff (ed.), Creeds of Christendom, vol. II (The History of Creeds): Nicaeno-Constantinopolitan Creed (381) and Athanasian Creed, Greek/Latin/English
edition_note: CCEL plain-text cache of Schaff, Creeds of Christendom vol. II, 6th ed. (https://ccel.org/ccel/schaff/creeds2.html); English and Latin on facing lines, Greek in transliteration in this copy
notes: Primary Christian text. Schaff's English for Athanasius is an 'Old Translation Revised'. Bracketed words [Filioque] are Schaff's critical brackets (Western addition), not part of the Eastern text.

title_es_or_en: Basil of Caesarea, Letter 38 (to his brother Gregory) on ousia and hypostasis; and Letter/treatise passages on the Holy Spirit's peculiar hypostatic notes
edition_note: Schaff & Wace (eds.), NPNF2 vol. 8, Basil: Letters and Select Works, tr. Blomfield Jackson (Edinburgh: T&T Clark, 1895). CCEL plain-text cache https://ccel.org/ccel/s/schaff/npnf208/cache/npnf208.txt
notes: Basil's Against Eunomius is cited only through an editorial paraphrase by Dorner in the NPNF volume; not used as a Basil quotation.

title_es_or_en: Gregory of Nazianzus, Oration 31 (Fifth Theological Oration, On the Holy Spirit)
edition_note: Schaff & Wace (eds.), NPNF2 vol. 7, Cyril of Jerusalem, Gregory Nazianzen (New York: Christian Literature Publishing Co., 1893), tr. Charles Gordon Browne & James Edward Swallow. CCEL plain-text cache https://ccel.org/ccel/s/schaff/npnf207/cache/npnf207.txt
notes: Section numerals (I-XIX) are those of the Oration; bracketed numbers [3700] etc. are NPNF page markers of the Benedictine (Migne) edition, not part of the text.

title_es_or_en: Augustine, De Trinitate, Book V (On the Holy Trinity), ch. 2-10
edition_note: Schaff (ed.), NPNF1 vol. 3, On the Holy Trinity (New York: Christian Literature Publishing Co., 1890), tr. Arthur West Haddan (rev. W. G. T. Shedd). CCEL plain-text cache https://ccel.org/ccel/s/schaff/npnf103/cache/npnf103.txt
notes: Paragraph numbers (5, 6, 8, 9...) are the standard De Trinitate paragraph numbers as printed in NPNF.

title_es_or_en: John of Damascus, An Exact Exposition of the Orthodox Faith (De fide orthodoxa), Book I, ch. 8 (Concerning the Holy Trinity)
edition_note: Schaff & Wace (eds.), NPNF2 vol. 9, Hilary of Poitiers, John of Damascus (Edinburgh: T&T Clark, 1898), tr. S. D. F. Salmond. CCEL plain-text cache https://ccel.org/ccel/s/schaff/npnf209/cache/npnf209.txt
notes: Bracketed numbers [1487] etc. are Migne column markers.

title_es_or_en: Thomas Aquinas, Summa Theologiae I, q.28 (divine relations), q.29 (divine persons), q.30 (plurality of persons), q.39 (persons in relation to the essence)
edition_note: Fathers of the English Dominican Province (trans.), Summa Theologica (Second and Revised Edition, 1920; Benziger Bros.), as hosted at New Advent (https://www.newadvent.org/summa/1028.htm, 1029, 1030, 1039)
notes: Article numbers verified in the New Advent text. q.27 pages fetched but not yet used.

title_es_or_en: Fourth Lateran Council (1215), constitution 1 'Firmiter' (Profession of faith against Joachim of Fiore / on the Trinity)
edition_note: Fordham University Medieval Sourcebook, 'Fourth Lateran Council, 1215' (https://sourcebooks.fordham.edu/basis/lateran4.asp)
notes: Translation not checked against Latin Denzinger text.

title_ar: الجواب الصحيح لمن بدل دين المسيح
title_es_or_en: Ibn Taymiyya, al-Jawab al-sahih li-man baddala din al-Masih
edition_note: OpenITI text of Ibn Taymiyya, al-Jawab al-sahih (Shamela 0000170); page numbers from OpenITI PageV markers of the printed edition named in the header (Ali b. Hasan et al. ed., 6 vols; check header)
notes: Quotes Christian texts (Paul of Antioch's letter; Christian formulas) inside Ibn Taymiyya's text; each passage marks which words are Christian, reported, or his own.

title_es_or_en: Sara Leila Husseini, 'Early Christian explanations of the Trinity in Arabic in the context of Muslim theology' (PhD, Birmingham, 2011); chapters on Abu Qurra, Abu Ra'ita, Ammar al-Basri
edition_note: Open PDF https://etheses.bham.ac.uk/id/eprint/2799/1/Husseini_11_PhD.pdf ; printed page numbers from footer (PDF page minus 12 in the parts read)
genre: secondary scholarship (read in part via pdftotext)
notes: Read: pp. 137-145 (Abu Qurra, Abu Ra'ita background), 213-217 and 263 (Ammar), 376, 382, 386, 397 (attributes vs hypostases). Quotations of Suermann inside it are not checked against Suermann.

title_es_or_en: Ismail Abdullah, 'Tawhid and Trinity: A Study of Ibn Taymiyyah's al-Jawab al-Sahih', Intellectual Discourse 14(1), 2006, pp. 89-106
edition_note: Open PDF https://journals.iium.edu.my/intdiscourse/index.php/id/article/download/89/86/150 (read in full text extraction)
notes: English translation of Paul of Antioch's letter as quoted by Ibn Taymiyya, pp. 98-99; the translator's Arabic is not given.

title_es_or_en: Bishara Ebeid, 'The Divine Substance as Aristotle's Substantia Prima: Yahya b. Adi and his Trinitarian Doctrine', Le Muséon 136 (2023), DOI 10.2143/MUS.136.3.3292533
edition_note: Record and abstract read (WebFetch of https://iris.unive.it/handle/10278/5049800); full text not read
notes: Confirms the analogies of Zayd and of intellect in Yahya b. Adi. Does not give the physician/calculator/scribe example.
